final_claim: Exactly \(1440\) labeled six-vertex tournaments satisfy \(BP(T)\ne MC(T)\); every strict case has \(|BP|=5\) and \(MC=A\), and the strict layer is exactly two isomorphism classes of orbit size \(720\) each.
